details:
SPACE EXAT — MARS EXPLORER

Developed by Aryan Bishwakarma | Space Exat

Space Exat Mars Explorer is an interactive web-based planetary exploration platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, inspired by the challenge “Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map.”

What does it do?

The platform helps users explore and understand Mars through an interactive experience. It presents Martian terrain information, water ice research, scientific locations, environmental hazards, and coordinate-based distance measurement. Users can explore selected Martian regions, learn about important locations such as Jezero Crater and Gale Crater, and calculate approximate distances between two coordinates on Mars.

Benefits and Intended Impact

The project makes Mars exploration information easier to access and understand. It introduces users to the geographical and environmental challenges of Mars, including extreme cold, dust storms, and difficult terrain. Its intended impact is to support planetary science education, encourage interest in space exploration, and provide an educational foundation for understanding future Mars mission planning.

Tools and Technologies

The project was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. HTML structures the website, CSS provides its visual design and responsive layout, and JavaScript powers interactive elements and coordinate-based distance calculations. NASA's publicly available resources, including NASA Mars Trek, NASA Planetary Data System, and NASA Mars science resources, were used for research and scientific context.

Creativity and Design

The project combines planetary science information with an interactive web experience. Its visual dashboard organizes different Martian information layers into one platform, making complex exploration topics easier to explore and understand.

Factors Considered

The project considers Mars's geographical features, environmental conditions, scientific relevance, accessibility of information, and the importance of understanding distances between locations. Distance results are approximate and do not represent terrain-aware or safety-verified routes.

Our Vision

Space Exat Mars Explorer aims to make planetary exploration more understandable and inspire the next generation to explore beyond Earth.

Built by Space Exat. Designed for the Future.
